quote:
The only Resident Evil game I really loved was Resident Evil 7: Biohazard, so I wasn’t sure what to expect going into this one.I have to say, though, this game was pretty damn good! The graphics are absolutely incredible, the environments look fantastic, and there are some genuinely great scares 
throughout.I really enjoyed the experience. It captured enough of that horror atmosphere to keep me engaged, and I absolutely loved it.A great Resident Evil experience. Beautiful graphics, fantastic scares, and definitely worth playing!

author: tap7744
quote: As a longtime Hellraiser fan, I can honestly say this game is an absolute masterpiece. They did a phenomenal job bringing the Hellraiser universe to **** gameplay is genuinely fun, the atmosphere is incredible, and the jump scares are fantastic. The horror elements are executed perfectly, and there were moments that genuinely got under my skin.This is exactly what I want from a Hellraiser game. author: tap7744
quote: A Massive Disappointment – The open world is fantastic, and there are some major improvements over previous games. Unfortunately, after playing roughly 6 hours of the campaign, I found myself struggling to stay interested. What started as excitement quickly turned into boredom and **** story feels like an incredibly bad girlfriend simulator. The male protagonist comes across as a complete simp, while the female protagonist is genuinely difficult to like. The writing feels amateurish, almost like something a first-time screenwriter would put together.I’ve played every GTA game, and I honestly never expected to be this disappointed by a Rockstar title. I can genuinely say I only laughed once during my time playing. For a franchise known for its humor, memorable characters, and incredible storytelling, that’s embarrassing.I honestly want my money **** developers seem to have completely lost sight of what made Grand Theft Auto such a great franchise in the first place. The open world might be impressive, but beautiful graphics and a massive map cannot compensate for a terrible story and unlikable characters.Rockstar, you need to seriously reconsider the direction you’re taking this franchise. Based on my experience, this was a massive disappointment. You missed the mark completely.
